---
title: Examples
description: Small question sets that can be copied into a presentation configuration.
---

These examples contain only the `questions` portion of `quiz.yml`. Combine them
with the presentation, Firebase, and session settings from
[Your first quiz](../../user-guide/first-quiz.html).

Each question ID must be unique in the final file, and every `after_slide` value
must refer to a page that exists in the PDF.
